title: Data and code for: Plantwide Control Design for Highly Load-Flexible Power-to-X Processes – A Systematic Procedure Applied to Renewable Ammonia Production
description:
Data and code for the manuscript "Plantwide Control Design for Highly Load-Flexible Power-to-X Processes: A Systematic Procedure Applied to Renewable Ammonia Production" (N. Groll, J.K. Huusom, G. Sin), submitted to Computers & Chemical Engineering.

The repository contains the open-loop and closed-loop responses of all control loops, with the identified process parameters, gain matrices, RGAs, aggregated RGA, Niederlinski index and SIMC tunings behind the figures and tables of the paper; the load-step and ramp validation tests of the basic and the advanced control system; and the Python code for the step tests, the identification and tuning, and the pairing analysis, with example scripts.

The dynamic simulation models (AVEVA Process Simulation) are not included, as the software license does not allow us to redistribute them. Researchers with a valid license can contact the corresponding author.
